blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As vision-language models (VLMs) transition from frozen-encoder pipelines to native multimodal architectures, the visual channel increasingly serves as both a perceptual input and a carrier of rendered text that competes with user prompts. Current single-attack, pixel-centric evaluations fail to capture this complexity: they collapse distinct visual attack surfaces into a single scalar and ignore how architectural shifts alter vulnerability. We introduce PaRMA, an evidence-based auditing framework that defines pathway-conditioned risk over two primary image-level interventions: pixel perturbation and rendered-text insertion. Instead of arbitrary attack enumeration, PaRMA uses pathway-specific diagnostics to expose architecture-specific blind spots. Notably, we uncover a see-but-not-deceived signature where native VLMs attend heavily to typographic overlays but visually reject them, and we identify an objective mismatch between encoder-level and answer-level attacks in deep-fusion models. To exploit these findings, we instantiate FusionAudit, introducing two diagnostic-motivated attacks: MANTIS (margin-aware pixel perturbation) and Nat-Evid (host-congruent semantic insertion). Evaluating 18 open-weight VLMs across a novel nativeness taxonomy, we demonstrate that legacy single-attack rankings (e.g., PGD) are unstable for native models. Our diagnostic-driven attacks substantially raise the estimated residual risk, showing that PaRMA provides a falsifiable, evidence-driven auditing methodology for uncovering vulnerabilities missed by standard benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)从冷冻-编码器管道向本土多模式架构的过渡,视觉通道日益成为与用户提示相竞争的已渲染文本的感知输入和载体. 目前的单发攻击,以像素为中心的评价未能捕捉到这种复杂性:它们会把明显的视觉攻击表面倒塌成一个单一的平板,而忽略建筑转变如何改变脆弱性. 我们采用了基于证据的审计框架PARMA,它界定了两种主要图像层面干预措施的路径条件风险:像素扰动和提供文本插入。 PARMA没有任意攻击点数,而是使用路径特异性的诊断来暴露建筑特异性的盲点. 值得注意的是,我们发现了一种可见但不可见的签名,即当地VLM大量参与打字,但视而不见,我们发现在深度聚变模型中编码器级和答案级攻击之间的客观不匹配。 为了利用这些发现,我们即时进行FusionAudit,引入了两个有诊断动机的攻击:MANTIS(边际-意识像素扰动)和Nat-Evid(主-相通语义插入). 对18个开放量级的VLM进行全新本土分类评价,我们表明,遗留下来的单发攻击排名(如PGD)对于本土模型来说是不稳定的. 我们的诊断驱动攻击大大增加了估计的残余风险,表明PARMA为发现标准基准所遗漏的脆弱性提供了可伪造的由证据驱动的审计方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are undergoing a structural transition. Early systems treated the visual channel as a peripheral sensor, piping a frozen vision encoder into a pretrained language model via a projection bottleneck. Today, native multimodal architectures—featuring multi-layer visual injection and early-fusion shared backbones [ 4 , 41 , 15 ] —process visual and textual tokens in a unified representational space from the earliest layers. In this paradigm, pixels, scene text, and document fields compete directly with the user’s prompt. However, robustness evaluation has not kept pace. Current protocols remain siloed into pixel-space adversarial attacks [ 61 , 8 ] and typographic overlays [ 18 ] , neither of which accounts for the deep integration of native VLMs.
blocks.zh: 愿景语言模型正在经历结构转型。 早期系统将视觉通道作为外围传感器处理,通过投影瓶颈将一个冷冻的视觉编码器插入预训语言模型. 今天,本土的多式联运建筑——用于多层视觉注射和早期聚变的共享骨干[4,41,15]——从最早的地层,在统一的代表空间中处理视觉和文字符号. 在这个范式中,像素,场景文本,文档字段与用户的提示直接竞争. 然而,稳健性评价没有跟上步伐。 目前的协议仍然被排入像素-空间对抗攻击[61,8]和排版覆盖[18],两者都无法解释本土VLM的深度融合.

blocks.en: This structural gap leaves two critical blind spots in current evaluations. First, on the pixel pathway, legacy attacks anchored at the vision encoder ignore deep decoder-side gradients. Conversely, standard end-to-end attacks (e.g., PGD [ 29 ] ) spread gradient pressure across all output tokens, underweighting the exact position where the model commits to a wrong answer. Second, on the rendered-text pathway, native VLMs exhibit a striking see-but-not-deceived signature: attention diagnostics indicate that these models allocate heavy attention to overlaid text, yet they resist adopting it as a task response. This suggests native VLMs develop a fine-grained sensitivity to visual congruence, making direct typographic attacks incomplete and leaving additional semantic failures unmeasured due to visual rejection.
blocks.zh: 这一结构性差距在目前的评价中留下两个关键的盲点。 首先,在像素路径上,固定在视觉编码器上的遗留攻击忽略了深层解码器侧梯度. 反之,标准端对端攻击(如PGD[29])将梯度压力分散在所有输出符上,低估了模型承诺错误答案的确切位置. 第二,在渲染文字的路径上,原生的VLM显示出一个引人注目的可见但非欺骗的特征:注意诊断表明,这些模型将大量注意力放在了上加的文字上,但是它们不愿将其作为任务对策。 这表明本地的VLM对视觉相容性发展出精细的灵敏度,使得直接的排印攻击不完整,并且使得额外的语义故障由于视觉排斥而得不到衡量.

blocks.en: We argue that robustness auditing for native VLMs should be an evidence-based methodology rather than a static benchmark. We introduce PaRMA (Pathway-conditioned Risk for Multimodal Auditing), a framework that organizes the visual channel into two primary intervention families: pixel perturbation ( π pix \pi_{\mathrm{pix}} ) and rendered-text insertion ( π txt \pi_{\mathrm{txt}} ). Instead of blindly enumerating attacks, PaRMA uses behavioral and gradient diagnostics to expose architecture-specific blind spots, which then motivate the design of diagnostic-motivated interventions. We instantiate this framework as FusionAudit . Guided by our diagnostic findings, FusionAudit introduces two strengthened attacks: MANTIS , a margin-aware pixel attack that concentrates gradients at the first-divergence token to address this mismatch; and Nat-Evid , a host-congruent semantic intervention that naturalizes text payloads to bypass visual rejection. The audit’s principal scalar is the residual pathway-complete risk, yielding an empirical lower bound on pathway-complete risk.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,对当地自愿工序的稳健性审计应当是一种循证方法,而不是一个静态基准。 我们引入了PARMA(Pathway-有条件的多式联运审计风险),这个框架将视觉通道组织成两个主要干预家族:像素扰动( pix\pi_{\mathrm{pix}})和渲染文本插入(πtxt\pi_{\mathrm{txt}}). PARMA没有盲目地列举攻击,而是使用行为和梯度诊断来揭露建筑上特有的盲点,从而激励了以诊断为动机的干预的设计. 我们立即将这个框架作为 " 融合审计 " 。 FusionAudit以我们的诊断结论为指导,引入了两种强化攻击: MANTIS,一种差分意识像素攻击,将梯度集中到第一潜水器的标志,以解决这种不匹配;Nat-Evid,一种宿主-共性语义干预,将文本有效载荷归化以绕过视觉拒绝. 审计的主要尺度是剩余路径完成风险,从而在路径完成风险上产生经验性较低的约束。

blocks.en: Contributions. Our core contributions are: • We identify native VLM robustness as a structurally distinct problem, introducing a graded nativeness taxonomy ( L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} – L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} ) to organize audit targets across fusion designs. • We propose PaRMA and FusionAudit, an evidence-based auditing methodology. We uncover the see-but-not-deceived signature in native VLMs and introduce diagnostic-motivated attacks (MANTIS, Nat-Evid) specifically designed to exploit these diagnostic findings. • We conduct an extensive 18-model audit demonstrating that legacy single-attack proxies produce unstable rankings for native models. Our diagnostic-driven attacks substantially raise the estimated residual visual-channel risk, showing that current evaluations can underestimate VLM vulnerabilities.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early Vision-language Models (VLMs) typically used modular architectures [ 37 , 14 , 51 ] , connecting a frozen or lightly adapted vision encoder to a language model through a projection layer, query module, or connector [ 1 , 50 , 47 ] . Models like BLIP-2 [ 24 ] , InstructBLIP [ 14 ] , MiniGPT-4 [ 62 ] , and LLaVA [ 26 ] showed that this alignment-era pipeline supports visual question answering, captioning, and visual instruction tuning [ 53 , 16 ] . Later work systematically examined how vision backbones, connectors, and training recipes affect VLM behavior [ 22 , 43 , 9 , 27 , 4 ] . Recent native multimodal models instead adopt multi-layer visual injection or early-fusion shared backbones, allowing visual and textual information to interact earlier or deeper in computation [ 41 , 52 , 12 , 28 , 54 , 42 , 15 ] . This shift means the visual channel is no longer merely a frontend conditioning signal, so robustness evaluation must move beyond assumptions inherited from modular pipelines.
blocks.zh: 早期视觉语言模型(VLMs)通常使用模块化架构[37,14,51],通过投影层,查询模块,或连接器[1,50,47]将冷冻或轻度调整的视觉编码器与语言模型连接起来. BLIP-2 [24],IstructBLIP [14],MiniGPT-4 [62],LLaVA [26]等模型显示,这种对齐时代的管道支持视觉问答,字幕,以及视觉指示调音[53,16]. 后来的工作系统地研究了视觉骨干、连接器和培训食谱如何影响VLM行为[22、43、9、27、4]。 最近的本地多式联运模式则采用多层视觉注射或早期聚变共享骨干,允许视觉和文字信息在计算中更早或更深入地相互作用[41、52、12、28、54、42、15]。 这种转变意味着视觉通道不再仅仅是前端的调节信号,所以强性评价必须超越从模块化管道中继承的假设.

blocks.en: Classical adversarial robustness work shows that small-norm pixel perturbations and PGD-style attacks can expose systematic vulnerabilities in visual models [ 7 , 29 ] . These methods have been adapted to VLMs to attack vision encoder representations, cross-modal alignment, or final generated responses [ 38 , 45 , 61 , 55 ] . Prior studies further show that large VLMs remain sensitive to visual perturbations and that adversarial examples can transfer across models [ 39 , 8 , 33 , 49 , 48 , 46 , 56 , 57 , 58 , 59 , 60 ] . Beyond pixel-space attacks, typographic attacks demonstrate that text rendered inside images can alter a VLM’s interpretation of visual content [ 18 , 31 , 20 , 11 ] . However, existing evaluations usually treat pixel perturbations and text overlays as separate threat vectors, without systematically measuring joint risk across visual pathways in native VLMs [ 5 , 3 , 21 , 36 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 古典对抗力强性工作显示,小规范像素扰动和PGD式攻击可以暴露视觉模型的系统性弱点[7,29]. 这些方法已根据VLM进行修改,以攻击视觉编码器的表示、跨模式的配合或最后生成的响应[38、45、61、55]。 先前的研究进一步表明,大型VLM对视觉扰动仍然敏感,对抗性实例可以跨模型转移[39、8、33、49、48、46、56、57、58、59、60]。 除了像素空间攻击外,印刷攻击还表明,图像内部提供的文本可以改变VLM对视觉内容的解释[18, 31, 20, 11]. 然而,现有的评价通常将像素扰动和文本覆盖作为单独的威胁载体,而不系统地衡量在原生VLM中跨越视觉路径的联合风险[5,3,21,36,40].

blocks.en: Robustness evaluation has long recognized that single attacks can underestimate risk [ 2 ] , motivating fixed attack suites such as AutoAttack [ 13 ] . Multimodal robustness evaluations have begun to aggregate diverse perturbations and attacks, but most still rely on predefined static suites [ 45 ] . In parallel, diagnostic tools including representation similarity, attention analysis, and activation patching help reveal internal representations and behavioral mechanisms [ 6 , 44 , 19 , 35 , 25 ] . Yet these diagnostics are typically used post hoc to explain failures rather than to guide stronger subsequent attacks [ 23 , 34 , 17 ] . PaRMA instead integrates pathway-specific diagnostics into the audit, reporting residual risk after diagnostic-driven strengthening rather than the maximum over a pre-specified collection.
blocks.zh: 强力评价早已认识到,单次攻击可以低估风险[2],激发AutoAttack[13]等固定攻击套件. 多式联运稳健性评价已经开始汇总各种扰动和攻击,但大多数仍然依赖于预先定义的静态套件[45]. 同时,诊断工具,包括表现相似性、注意力分析和激活补丁有助于揭示内部表现和行为机制[6、44、19、35、25]。 然而,这些诊断通常在事后用于解释失败,而不是指导更强烈的后续攻击[23、34、17]。 相反,PARMA将特定路径的诊断纳入审计,在诊断驱动下加强后报告剩余风险,而不是预先规定的收集的最大风险。

blocks.en: 3 Native Multimodal VLMs: Taxonomy and Threat Scope
blocks.zh: 3 本土多式联运 分类和威胁范围

blocks.en: The transition from modular pipelines to native multimodal training alters the VLM attack surface. In pipeline models, a projection bottleneck isolates the vision encoder from the language backbone. Deep fusion removes this bottleneck, altering end-to-end gradient paths, while joint early-layer attention forces visual and textual tokens to compete directly. To systematically audit this evolving landscape, we introduce a graded nativeness taxonomy and formalize the visual threat scope.
blocks.zh: 从模块化管道向本土多式联运训练的过渡改变了VLM攻击表面. 在管道模型中,一个投影瓶颈将视觉编码器与语言骨干隔离. 深度聚变消除了这个瓶颈,改变了端到端的梯度路径,而联合早期的注意则迫使视觉和文字上的符号直接竞争. 为了系统地审计这一不断变化的地貌,我们引入了分级本土分类法,并将视觉威胁范围正规化。

blocks.en: 3.1 Nativeness Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.1 土著分类学

blocks.en: We categorize VLMs based on their fusion depth and pretraining strategy. Fusion level co-varies with model family, scale, and training data, so level-wise trends are correlational. This taxonomy serves as an organizational axis for our audit, rather than a strict causal ladder:
blocks.zh: 我们根据其聚变深度和预训策略对VLM进行分类. 与模范家庭,规模,培训数据合并的同级,所以水平级趋势是相互关联的. 这种分类法是我们审计的组织轴心,而不是严格的因果关系:

blocks.en: • L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} (Alignment-era): A frozen or lightly adapted vision encoder connects to a language model via a projection module [ 26 , 62 ] . Modalities remain in structurally separate spaces; the bottleneck is the only junction. • L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} (Shallow fusion): Models feature large-scale joint multimodal pretraining. Visual tokens enter the backbone through a connector, but do not re-enter computation at deeper layers; the backbone processes a fixed visual prefix. • L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} (Deep/early fusion): Visual information participates throughout the language computation. This includes DeepStack (DS) models that re-inject visual features across multiple layers [ 4 ] , and Early Fusion (EF) models that share transformer blocks between modalities from the first layer [ 42 , 15 ] . A theoretical fourth level ( L 4 \mathrm{L}_{4} )—a strict single-backbone design unifying all modalities under one tokenizer without a distinct vision tower—completes the continuum, though no audited open-weight model currently meets this threshold.
blocks.zh: • L 1\mathrm{L}_{1}(对齐时代): 冷冻或轻度调整的视觉编码器通过投影模块[26,62]连接到语言模型. 模式仍然存在于结构上独立的空间中;瓶颈是唯一的交叉点。 • L 2\mathrm{L}_{2}(沙洛夫聚变): 模式的特点是大规模联合多式联运预训。 视觉符通过连接器进入骨干,但不会在更深层重新进入计算;骨干处理一个固定的视觉前缀. • L 3\mathrm{L}_{3}(深度/早期聚变): 视觉信息在整个语言计算过程中参与。 这包括DepStack(DS)模型,通过多层重新注入视觉特征[4],以及早期融合(EF)模型,从第一层开始在模式之间共享变压器块[42,15]. 理论上的第四层(L 4\mathrm{L}_{4})——一种严格的单背骨设计,将所有模式统一在一个没有明显视觉塔的显像器下——完成了连续体,尽管目前没有经过审计的开放量模型达到这个阈值.

blocks.en: 3.2 Audit Scope and Visual Pathways
blocks.zh: 3.2 审计范围和视觉途径

blocks.en: We formalize a VLM as a function mapping a visual input x v x_{v} and a text prompt x t x_{t} to an answer. To isolate visual-channel vulnerabilities from text-only jailbreaks, our audit fixes the text prompt and intervenes exclusively on x v x_{v} . Crucially, all empirical Attack Success Rates (ASRs) in our evaluation are strictly conditioned on the model’s clean-correct set —the subset of examples the model answers correctly before any intervention.
blocks.zh: 我们正式确定一个 VLM 作为函数 映射一个视觉输入 x v x_{v} 和一个文本提示 x t x_{t} 到一个答案 。 为了将视觉通道的弱点与文字漏洞隔离开来,我们的审计会及时修正文字,并专门干预xv x_{v}. 关键是,我们评价中的所有经验性攻击成功率都严格地以模型的整齐正确套件为条件,即模型在干预之前正确回答的子集。

blocks.en: We decompose the visual attack surface into two primary pathways: 1. Perceptual corruption ( π pix \pi_{\text{pix}} ): Pixel-space perturbations. In deep-fusion architectures, the unbroken gradient path from output loss to pixels can expose failures missed by attacks centered on L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} -style bottlenecks. 2. Rendered-text insertion ( π txt \pi_{\text{txt}} ): Typographic overlays. Added image text competes with existing visual evidence and the user’s prompt within the joint attention mechanism.

blocks.en: The Audit Problem. Given a model and a dataset, a pathway-complete robustness audit estimates the failure probability over the clean-correct set induced by the union of pathway-specific interventions. Crucially, it should diagnose whether these failures exhibit behavioral signatures that can guide stronger attacks.
blocks.zh: 审计问题. 鉴于一个模型和一个数据集,路径完备性审计估计了与路径特定干预措施相结合而导致的整组干净正确性失败概率。 关键是,它应该判断这些失败是否表现出能引导更强攻击的行为特征.

blocks.en: 4 Method: PaRMA and FusionAudit
blocks.zh: 4 方法:PARMA和FusionAudit

blocks.en: We operationalize our threat scope through PaRMA (Pathway-conditioned Risk for Multimodal Auditing). Unlike static benchmarks, PaRMA is a diagnostic-driven audit protocol: baseline attacks yield diagnostic signals, which in turn guide the design of diagnostic-motivated augmented attacks. We instantiate this framework as FusionAudit over two visual pathways (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过PARMA(有条件的多式联运审计风险)实施我们的威胁范围。 与静态基准不同,PARMA是一种诊断驱动的审计协议:基线攻击产生诊断信号,这反过来又指导了诊断动机增强攻击的设计. 我们通过两条视觉路径(图1),

blocks.en: Figure 1 : The PaRMA framework and FusionAudit pipeline. Native VLMs are evaluated over two visual pathways: pixel perturbation and rendered-text insertion. Baseline attacks (Vis-PGD, End-PGD, Typo-Evid) yield initial failures and diagnostic readouts. These diagnostics surface architecture-associated failure signatures (e.g., the see-but-not-deceived signature), guiding the generation of diagnostic-motivated augmented attacks (MANTIS, Nat-Evid) to compute the final falsifiable residual risk R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} .
blocks.zh: 图1:PARMA框架和FusionAudit管道。 原生VLM通过两个视觉路径进行评估:像素扰动和渲染文本插入. 基线攻击(Vis-PGD, end-PGD, Typo-Evid)产生初始故障和诊断读取. 这些诊断性表面结构相关故障签名(如见但非失明的签名),引导生成诊断性增强攻击(MANTIS,Nat-Evid),以计算最终可伪造的残余风险R ^ +\ gladhat{R}.

blocks.en: 4.3 Diagnostic-Driven Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.3 诊断性强化

blocks.en: The baseline analyses indicate two limitations: End-PGD spreads gradient pressure across the sequence (Eq. 3 ), and Typo-Evid triggers visual rejection. We introduce two diagnostic-motivated augmentations to close these gaps.
blocks.zh: 基线分析表明有两个局限性: end-PGD将梯度压力分散到整个序列(Eq. 3),Typo-Evid触发视觉拒绝. 我们采取了两个有诊断动机的强化措施来弥补这些差距。

blocks.en: MANTIS ( M argin- A ware N ative T oken I ntervention S trategy). To strengthen the pixel pathway audit, MANTIS abandons full-sequence loss. Let y + y^{+} be the canonical correct continuation and y − y^{-} be a deterministic canonical wrong continuation derived from the reference answer. Both continuations are fixed before optimization. MANTIS concentrates gradient pressure exclusively at t ⋆ t^{\star} , the first token where the two continuations diverge: t ⋆ = min ⁡ { t : y t + ≠ y t − } . t^{\star}=\min\{t:y^{+}_{t}\neq y^{-}_{t}\}. It then optimizes the margin at this first-divergence position: max ‖ δ ‖ ∞ ≤ ε ⁡ [ log ⁡ p θ ​ ( y t ⋆ − ∣ ϕ pix ​ ( x v , δ ) , x t , y < t ⋆ − ) − log ⁡ p θ ​ ( y t ⋆ + ∣ ϕ pix ​ ( x v , δ ) , x t , y < t ⋆ + ) ] . \max_{\|\delta\|_{\infty}\leq\varepsilon}\Bigl[\log p_{\theta}(y^{-}_{t^{\star}}\mid\phi_{\text{pix}}(x_{v};\delta),x_{t},y^{-}_{<t^{\star}})-\log p_{\theta}(y^{+}_{t^{\star}}\mid\phi_{\text{pix}}(x_{v};\delta),x_{t},y^{+}_{<t^{\star}})\Bigr]. (7)

Nat-Evid (Naturalized Evidence). The wrong answer w w is rendered as host-congruent native content (e.g., a chart annotation or scene text) rather than an extrinsic superimposition. The wrong answer w w is fixed before generation, and the editor is instructed to add text only, without modifying or removing existing content.

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets and Models. We evaluate on a fixed 1500-sample VQA evaluation set, balanced across ChartQA [ 30 ] , DocVQA [ 32 ] , and MME [ 16 ] . These datasets span document understanding and visual reasoning scenarios where images naturally contain both perceptual content and rendered text. ChartQA and DocVQA are text-heavy, whereas 460 of the 500 MME examples (92%) come from natural-image categories (400 artwork, 60 celebrity) and the remaining 40 from a text-dense category (code reasoning). Restricting the MME evaluation to these natural images changes no level-mean ASR by more than 3.2 points, and the L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} MANTIS exclusive-flip rate is 37.0 % 37.0\% , against 36.4 % 36.4\% on all 500 MME examples, so the level-wise patterns also hold on natural-image VQA. We select open-weight VLMs that cover the proposed nativeness levels while keeping parameter scales within the same broad range whenever possible, so that level comparisons are not dominated by a small-versus-large model contrast. The final 18-model inventory contains four L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} models (SmolVLM2-2.2B, BLIP2-OPT-2.7B, InstructBLIP-Vicuna-7B, LLaVA-1.5-7B), seven L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} models (Qwen-VL-Chat, Qwen2-VL-2B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B, Gemma3-4B/12B, DeepSeek-VL-7B), and seven L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} models (Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B, Qwen3.5-2B/4B/9B, Gemma4-E4B). Within this inventory, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, and Qwen3.5 form a same-family controlled chain from shallow to deep fusion at nearby parameter scales, which helps contextualize the cross-family level aggregates.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. For paired comparison, all attacks are evaluated on the exact same 1500-sample evaluation set. Crucially, all Attack Success Rates (ASRs) and risk estimators are conditioned strictly on each model’s clean-correct set ( n c n_{c} )—the subset of examples the model answers correctly before any intervention. Pixel attacks use an ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} budget of ε = 8 / 255 \varepsilon=8/255 with 40 PGD steps. When a model exhausts memory at the native image size, we compute the perturbation on a resized image, upsample only the noise field, and add it back to the original-resolution image before inference.

blocks.en: The Diagnostic-Driven Risk Gap. The main finding is that the diagnostic-driven suite yields higher risk estimates than the baseline suite. Across all fusion levels, the diagnostic-driven attacks expose additional failures. Moving from R ^ 0 \widehat{R}^{0} to R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} , the level-mean risk increases by + 10.6 % +10.6\% in L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} , + 16.9 % +16.9\% in L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} , and + 25.1 % +25.1\% in L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} . blocks.en: The δ \delta columns and the R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} parentheticals make the additional-risk contribution of diagnostic-driven augmentation explicit. For the pixel pathway, the fraction of clean-correct examples broken exclusively by MANTIS—examples that survived both Vis-PGD and End-PGD—rises from 15.2 % 15.2\% in L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} , to 17.6 % 17.6\% in L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} , and peaks at 24.6 % 24.6\% in L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} . This supports our diagnostic premise: in deeper-fusion architectures, standard end-to-end loss can spread gradient pressure across the sequence, leaving failures that are surfaced by concentrating gradient at the answer-discriminative token. On the rendered-text pathway, Nat-Evid surfaces large but non-monotone exclusive-flip rates ( 10.4 % 10.4\% , 23.7 % 23.7\% , and 20.6 % 20.6\% across L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} – L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} ), with a particularly large 20.6 % 20.6\% of L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} clean-correct examples flipped after resisting Typo-Evid. At the full audit level, the exclusive additional-risk fraction grows from 10.6 % 10.6\% to 16.9 % 16.9\% to 25.1 % 25.1\% , even while the absolute residual risk ( R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} ) decreases in newer models ( 97.0 % → 88.4 % → 75.6 % 97.0\%\to 88.4\%\to 75.6\% ).

blocks.en: Within-Family Qwen Chain. The Qwen series provides a crucial within-family control to mitigate confounders—such as parameter scale and training data evolution—across our L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} – L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} taxonomy. Around the smaller scale, R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} decreases from Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} , 85.7%) to Qwen3-VL-2B/4B ( L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} , 82.7/78.9%) and Qwen3.5-2B/4B ( L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} , 78.0/68.1%). Around the larger scale, it decreases from Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} , 79.5%) to Qwen3-VL-8B ( L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} , 73.1%) and Qwen3.5-9B ( L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} , 59.5%). This same-family pattern is consistent with the overall level-wise trend in Table 1 . Crucially, while absolute vulnerability ( R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} ) is lower in newer models, the diagnostic-driven risk gap ( R ^ + − R ^ 0 \widehat{R}^{+}-\widehat{R}^{0} ) persists across the chain. This pattern is consistent with the view that MANTIS and Nat-Evid expose vulnerabilities associated with the native multimodal shift, rather than only reflecting a comparison between older and newer model families.

blocks.en: Ranking Instability and the Limits of Single-Attack Proxies. Historically, End-PGD ASR has served as the default proxy for VLM robustness. Our audit shows that this proxy can be insufficient for native architectures. Comparing the End-PGD ranking to the pathway-complete R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} ranking yields a Spearman ρ = 0.837 \rho=0.837 and Kendall τ b = 0.634 \tau_{b}=0.634 —correlated, but unstable enough to affect model-selection conclusions. Specifically, 8 out of 18 models shift by at least three ranks. For instance, Gemma3-12B appears highly robust under End-PGD (ranking 2nd), but its higher MANTIS ASR moves it to 7th under R ^ + \widehat{R}^{+} . This instability supports the motivation for PaRMA: pathway-specific failures can be missed by single-scalar, pixel-centric evaluations.

blocks.en: Ablation and Stability. One concern for white-box attacks is whether observed gains are artifacts of specific hyperparameter tuning. We conduct a stability ablation on a balanced 300-sample subset (100 from each dataset) across all 18 models. Figure 2 suggests that MANTIS’s gains are not only an artifact of hyperparameter tuning:

blocks.en: Random-Start Sensitivity (Fig. 2(a) ): We evaluate MANTIS across three seeds. The min-max variance is small relative to the absolute ASR, with a median standard deviation of just 1.3 % 1.3\% . This suggests that MANTIS is not heavily dependent on initialization.

blocks.en: Optimization Budget (Fig. 2(b) ): We sweep the PGD step count from 10 to 50 to verify that our 40-step audit budget is not under-optimized. The results show that ASR largely saturates by 30–40 steps. Pushing the budget to 50 steps yields only marginal level-mean gains ( + 2.8 % +2.8\% , + 1.0 % +1.0\% , and + 2.2 % +2.2\% for Levels 1–3), indicating that the 40-step setting is a reasonable audit budget.
blocks.zh: 优化预算(图2(b)): 我们把PGD步骤从10到50进行统计,以核实我们的40步审计预算是否不够理想。 结果显示,ASR基本上饱和了30–40步. 将预算推到50级只能产生边际水平平均收益(+2.8%+2.8+++2.8+++,+1.0+++1.0++,+2.2+2.2+++++),表明40级设置是合理的审计预算.

This suggests that the trend exposed by MANTIS is not specific to the chosen threat model capacity.

blocks.en: Layer Restoration. To locate where End-PGD flips are decided, we restore clean decoder activations on End-PGD-flipped examples. For each model, we take the first 40 clean-correct examples flipped by End-PGD (sorted by identifier), regenerate their adversarial images with the audit configuration, and keep the flips that reproduce (24–40 per model). For each depth ℓ \ell , we replace the prefill hidden states of decoder layers 0 0 through ℓ \ell with their values on the clean image, decode greedily, and count the flip as recovered if some depth restores the correct answer. Recovery falls with fusion level: 92.2 % 92.2\% [ 87.6 , 96.1 ] [87.6,96.1] in L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} , 62.6 % 62.6\% [ 55.5 , 69.6 ] [55.5,69.6] in L 2 \mathrm{L}_{2} , and 25.6 % 25.6\% [ 20.7 , 30.7 ] [20.7,30.7] in L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} (model-macro means with 95% fixed-model bootstrap CIs over 16 models; Qwen-VL-Chat and DeepSeek-VL-7B are excluded because their legacy implementations do not support activation hooks). Within the Qwen family, it falls from 70.4 % 70.4\% (Qwen2-VL-2B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B) to 21.3 % 21.3\% (Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5). In alignment-only models, restoring an early prefix of layers usually undoes the attack; in deep-fusion models, most flips survive restoration at every depth, consistent with visual features re-entering the computation across many layers. This is where an answer-level objective that targets the decision token, as in MANTIS, adds the most exclusive flips (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 层还原。 为了定位最终 PGD 翻转被决定的位置,我们恢复了 End-PGD-flipped 示例上的干净解码器激活. 对于每个模型,我们取前40个由 End-PGD 翻转的干净正确的例子(按标识符排序),用审计配置重现他们的对抗图像,并保留复制的翻转(每个模型24–40). 对于每个深度 l\ell,我们用其清空图像上的值来替换预填的解码层0至l\ell的隐藏状态,贪婪地解码,如果有深度恢复正确的答案,则将翻转算作恢复的. 回收量属于聚变水平:L 1\mathrm{L}_{1}中的92.2% [87.6,96.1][87.6,96.1],L 2\mathrm{L}_{2}中的62.6% [55.5,69.6],L 2\mathrm{L}_{2}中的25.6% [20.7,30.7] [20.7,30.7] L 3\mathrm{L}_{3}中的25.6% (模型-宏表示固定型靴式CI大于16个型号的95%;Quen-VL-Chat和Deepek-VL-7B由于遗留的应用不支持激活钩) 。 在Quen家族中,从70.4%(Qune2-VL-2B,Qune2.5-VL-3B/7B)下降到21.3%(Qune3-VL和Qune3.5)。 在只有对齐的模型中,恢复层的早期前缀通常可以抵消攻击;在深度聚变模型中,大多数翻转在每一个深度都能幸存恢复,与跨越许多层重新进入计算中的视觉特征一致. 正如MANTIS中那样,一个针对决定符号的回答级目标增加了最独有的翻转(表1)。

blocks.en: Generator Sensitivity. Because Nat-Evid relies on generative image editing, we test whether the attack’s success is tied to the idiosyncrasies of a specific generator. Figure 4 compares four Nat-Evid variants. While the Gemini-backed variant is the strongest (driven by MME), the three exact-text generators (GPT-Image-2 and two Qwen variants) produce highly consistent average ASRs ( ∼ 19 % \sim 19\% ). This suggests that the Nat-Evid effect is not tied to a single generator.
blocks.zh: 发电机灵敏度. 因为Nat-Evid依靠基因图像编辑, 我们测试攻击的成功是否与特定生成器的特异性有关。 图4比较了四个Nat-Evid变体. 双子座背式变体是最强的(由MME驱动),而三个精确的文本生成器(GPT-Image-2和两个Quen变体)则产生高度一致的平均ASR(~~19%\sim 19~~~). 这表明Nat-Evid效应没有与单个生成器绑定.

blocks.en: Ground-Truth Preservation. Nat-Evid edits are generated under strict text-only constraints, and we verify that they keep the original evidence intact. For natural images, we mask the inserted cue with a solid black patch on 100 MME examples that Qwen3-VL-8B answers correctly on the original image but wrongly under Nat-Evid; the correct answer returns in 98 of the 100 cases, so these failures come from the injected cue rather than from altered evidence. For charts and documents, a non-generative OCR engine recovers the exact ground-truth string from the edited image in 92.3% of the examples whose answer it can read in the original, and manual inspection of the remaining cases finds the evidence destroyed in only 0.85% of the images.
blocks.zh: 地面真理保护. Nat-Evid的编辑是在严格的文本限制下产生的,我们核实它们保留了原始证据的完整. 对于自然图像,我们在100个MME实例上用一个坚固的黑色补丁遮盖插入的提示,这些实例的Qune3-VL-8B在原始图像上正确回答,但在Nat-Evid下错误回答;正确的答案返回了100个案例中的98个,因此这些失败来自注入的提示而不是被改变的证据. 对于图表和文件,一个非遗传性的OCR引擎从92.3%的经编辑的图像中恢复准确的地面真实字符串,其答案可以读到原文,对剩余案例的人工检查发现只有0.85%的图像中销毁的证据.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: The transition to native multimodal architectures fundamentally alters the VLM attack surface, rendering legacy single-attack, pixel-centric evaluations insufficient. To address this, we introduced PaRMA and its instantiation, FusionAudit , an evidence-based auditing methodology. By leveraging pathway-specific diagnostics, we identified an objective mismatch on the pixel pathway and the see-but-not-deceived signature in deep-fusion models. These insights motivated our diagnostic-motivated interventions, MANTIS and Nat-Evid, which successfully exposed substantial residual risks systematically hidden by standard benchmarks across 18 VLMs. Ultimately, robustness auditing must evolve alongside architectures; FusionAudit provides a rigorous, pathway-complete template for this native multimodal era.
blocks.zh: 向本土多式联运结构的过渡从根本上改变了VLM攻击表面,使得遗留下来的单攻击,像素中心评价不足. 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了基于证据的审计方法PARMA及其即时分析FusionAudit。 通过利用路径特定诊断,我们发现在像素路径上存在客观的不匹配,在深度聚变模型中存在见但非见的特征. 这些洞察力激励着我们以诊断为动力的干预,即MANTIS和Nat-Evid,它们成功地暴露了在18个甚高压材料中被标准基准系统隐藏的大量剩余风险。 最终,稳健性审计必须与架构同时发展;FusionAudit为这个本土多式联运时代提供了一个严格的、完整的模板。

blocks.en: PaRMA can help model developers find visual-channel failures before deployment. The same attacks could also be used to mislead deployed VLMs; MANTIS requires white-box gradient access, and we release the audit pipeline rather than precomputed adversarial images.
blocks.zh: PARMA可以帮助模型开发者在部署前找到视觉通道故障. 同样的攻击也可以用来误导部署的VLM;MANTIS需要白框梯度访问,我们释放审计管道,而不是预先计算的对抗图像.

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations. First, our nativeness taxonomy ( L 1 \mathrm{L}_{1} – L 3 \mathrm{L}_{3} ) is an observational framework for auditing, not a strict causal ladder. The stricter L 4 \mathrm{L}_{4} endpoint remains outside our empirical audit: token-based mixed-modal systems such as Chameleon point toward this design, but the Chameleon paper reports image-tokenizer limitations on text-heavy images, which are central to our ChartQA, DocVQA, and rendered-text setting [ 41 ] . While the Qwen controlled chain mitigates some confounders, adjacent levels differ in training data and scale alongside fusion depth. Second, our rendered-text pathway focuses exclusively on task-relevant wrong-answer injection. Command-following visual prompt injection (e.g., jailbreaks) represents a distinct safety risk that requires compliance-based metrics rather than correctness-based ASR. Finally, while PaRMA currently instantiates two visual pathways, the framework is designed to be extensible. As VLMs expand to process audio, video, and embodied tool-use, new pathways and diagnostics can be added to PaRMA.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有几个局限性。 首先,我们的本土分类学(L 1\mathrm{L}_{1} – L 3\mathrm{L}_{3})是审计的观察框架,而不是严格的因果阶梯. 更严格的L 4\mathrm{L}_{4}结束点仍然在我们的经验性审计之外:像Chameleon这样的基于符号的混合模式系统指向这个设计,但Chameleon的论文报告了对文本重度图像的图像调试器限制,这些对于我们的 ChartQA, DocVQA, 以及渲染文本设置[41] . 虽然Quen控制链可以缓解一些困惑者,但相邻水平在训练数据和规模上随聚变深度而有所不同. 第二,我们的成文路径完全侧重于与任务有关的错误回答注入。 遵循命令的视觉即时注射(如越狱)是一种明显的安全风险,需要以遵守为基础的衡量标准,而不是以正确性为基础的ASR。 最后,虽然PARMA目前可以即时通过两个视觉路径,但框架的设计是可扩展的. 随着VLM扩展到处理音频,视频,以及包含的工具使用,PARMA可以添加新的路径和诊断.
